prompt: How many years had passed since the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania was admitted to the Union by the time Rep. Robert D. Heaton was born?
answer: Pennsylvania joined the Union on **December 12, 1787**, and Robert D. Heaton was born on **July 1, 1873**. Thus, about **86 years** had passed—more precisely, **85 full years and nearly 7 months**.
